sources.snippet: Ovis-Omni-Embedding-3B is a 3B-parameter universal embedding model for text, images, visual documents, video, audio, and interleaved multimodal inputs. It maps every supported input type into one coherent representation space, enabling any-to-any retrieval with a single encoder.

sources.snippet: Introduction Ovis-Omni-Embedding is an omni-modal embedding model developed by the Alibaba ATH-MaaS team. It maps heterogeneous modalities — including text, image, video, and audio — into a unified representation space, enabling comprehensive cross-modal retrieval and understanding within a single model.
